title: BrowseComp-Plus: A Fair and Disentangled Evaluation Benchmark for Deep Search Agents
authors_zh: Zijian Chen, Xueguang Ma, Shengyao Zhuang, Ping Nie, Kai Zou, Sahel Sharifymoghaddam, Andrew Liu, Joshua Green, Kshama Patel, Ruoxi Meng, Mingyi Su, Yanxi Li, Haoran Hong, Xinyu Shi, Xuye Liu, Hosna Oyarhoseini, Nandan Thakur, Crystina Zhang, Luyu Gao, Wenhu Chen, Jimmy Lin
paper_type_zh: 固定语料深度检索智能体评测基准与部分轨迹发布
best_for_zh: 研究 web/search agent、检索反馈、轨迹重放、judge 漂移与 benchmark 审计的读者
one_line: A fixed-corpus BrowseComp derivative with 830 answerable queries, 100,195 web documents, human evidence/gold qrels, mixed answer/retrieval/citation grading, and four released frontier-agent trajectory archives.
BrowseComp-Plus 将 BrowseComp 筛为 830 个可核验证据的查询，并配套 100,195 篇固定网页语料、人类 evidence/gold qrels、混合评测器与四组部分发布的完整 agent 轨迹。
why: It disentangles the search agent from live-web drift and exposes whether failures arise from retrieval, citation, terminal status, or answer synthesis. The fixed substrate and partial episode release support replay and audit, while judge drift, incomplete qrels, public reversible obfuscation, and unresolved web-content licensing remain important limits.
inclusion_reason: BrowseComp-Plus makes deep-search evaluation materially more auditable than a live-web QA score by fixing the corpus, releasing query/answer and human evidence/gold-document labels, defining retrieval/citation/answer verification, publishing executable agent clients and indexes, and releasing four representative full-trajectory archives. It belongs in the environment/agent-trajectory track as an evaluation substrate and partial trajectory release, not as evidence of post-training use.

title: Problem
问题
html:
BrowseComp-Plus asks how to evaluate deep-search agents without letting a changing live web blur retrieval quality, answer synthesis, and citation behavior into one score. Its archival record is the ACL 2026 paper BrowseComp-Plus: A Fair and Disentangled Evaluation Benchmark for Deep Search Agents. The stable Card ID retains 2025 from arXiv:2508.06600's first submission, while the title, year, venue, and 21-author list follow the formal ACL version.

The released benchmark unit is one of 830 filtered BrowseComp queries, paired with a short reference answer and document-level supervision over a fixed 100,195-document corpus. The query release exposes query_id, query, answer, evidence documents, gold documents, and negative documents; the payload other than query_id is reversibly obfuscated. The corpus exposes docid, text, and URL. Its Hugging Face split label is train only as a packaging label: the paper provides no evidence that this corpus or the benchmark records were used for model training.

The evaluation surface is larger than question-answer pairs. Search agents interact with released indexes, receive top-five results truncated to 512 tokens per document, may use an optional get_document action in the reported ablation, and terminate with an explanation, numeric document citations, a short answer, and confidence. Public episode files can include ordered tool calls, tool outputs, reasoning summaries when exposed, usage, retrieved document IDs, terminal status, and final output.

This task-plus-fixed-environment-plus-episode structure places the paper in environment_agent_trajectory_data. It should not be merged with browsecomp-2025: BrowseComp remains the parent 1,266-question source benchmark, whereas BrowseComp-Plus retains 830 questions and adds the frozen corpus, human evidence/gold qrels, hard negatives, indexes, graders, executable clients, and a partial trajectory release. The accepted metadata remains L3_summary_ready and partial; the Card is bilingual and audit-ready, but it does not pre-approve Review state or claim complete replay.

BrowseComp-Plus 研究如何在评测 deep-search agent 时避免动态 live web 把检索质量、答案合成与引用行为混成一个无法分解的分数。正式书目记录是 ACL 2026 论文 BrowseComp-Plus: A Fair and Disentangled Evaluation Benchmark for Deep Search Agents。Card 的 stable ID 依据 arXiv:2508.06600 在 2025 年的首次提交保留 -2025，但标题、年份、venue 与 21 位作者采用正式 ACL 版本。

公开 benchmark 的基本单位是从 BrowseComp 筛选出的 830 个查询之一；每条查询配有短参考答案，并在固定的 100,195 篇文档语料上提供 document-level supervision。query release 包含 query_id、query、answer、evidence document、gold document 与 negative document；除 query_id 外的 payload 均做了可逆混淆。corpus 公开 docid、text 与 URL。Hugging Face 把该 corpus 的 split 标为 train，但这只是打包标签：论文没有证据表明语料或 benchmark record 用于模型训练。

evaluation surface 不止是 question-answer pair。search agent 与公开 index 交互，每次接收 top-five 结果且每篇文档截断为 512 tokens；报告的消融实验还可选用 get_document action；最终输出 explanation、numeric document citation、短答案与 confidence。公开 episode file 可包含有序 tool call、tool output、可用时的 reasoning summary、usage、retrieved document ID、terminal status 与 final output。

这种 task-plus-fixed-environment-plus-episode 结构使论文归入 environment_agent_trajectory_data。本卡不能与 browsecomp-2025 合并：BrowseComp 仍是包含 1,266 个问题的 parent source benchmark，而 BrowseComp-Plus 只保留 830 个问题，并新增 frozen corpus、人类 evidence/gold qrels、hard negative、index、grader、可执行 client 与部分 trajectory release。accepted metadata 仍为 L3_summary_ready 和 partial；本卡达到双语与审计所需的内容深度，但不预先批准 Review 状态，也不声称可以完整 replay。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The central contribution is a fixed-corpus derivative of BrowseComp that separates three questions: whether the environment retrieved human-labeled evidence, whether the agent cited those evidence document IDs, and whether a semantic judge accepted the final answer. Freezing the search substrate removes live-web drift from the retrieval comparison, but it does not remove model-weight contamination or make the labels exhaustive.

The benchmark record combines four data objects. First are 830 test queries with answers. Second is a 100,195-document web corpus. Third are human evidence qrels, gold-document labels, and mined hard negatives: evidence supports one or more clues, a gold document semantically contains the final answer, and a hard negative is a scraped result not retained as positive after labeling and deduplication. Fourth is a partial set of full agent episodes. The public run inventory contains only BM25+GPT-5, BM25+o3, Qwen3-Embedding-8B+GPT-5, and Qwen3-Embedding-8B+o3; coverage of all 830 queries and success/failure distributions has not been exhaustively verified.

The feedback contract is mixed. Terminal validity is programmatic: status must be completed and a final answer must exist. Retrieval uses Recall@k and nDCG@k against human qrels. Citation recall matches numeric cited document IDs to evidence qrels, but does not test sentence-level entailment. Final-answer accuracy requires an LLM semantic-equivalence judge: the archival results use GPT-4.1, while current public code defaults to Qwen/Qwen3-32B. No pairwise preference, process reward, learned reward model, or optimizer is part of the evidenced release.

Relative to BrowseComp, the change is not a new set of 1,266 questions or a replacement scoring card. It is the controlled environment, document supervision, construction ledger, and partial episode observability around a retained 830-query subset. This distinction supports the category choice and the related: [browsecomp-2025] link while keeping training_use limited to evaluation.

核心贡献是构建一个基于固定语料的 BrowseComp 派生 benchmark，把三个问题分开：environment 是否检索到人类标注的 evidence、agent 是否引用这些 evidence document ID，以及 semantic judge 是否接受最终答案。固定 search substrate 可以从检索对比中移除 live-web drift，但不能消除 model-weight contamination，也不能使标签自动变得穷尽。

benchmark record 组合了四类 data object。第一类是带 answer 的 830 个 test query；第二类是包含 100,195 篇网页文档的 corpus；第三类是人类 evidence qrels、gold-document label 与挖掘的 hard negative：evidence 支持答案所需的一个或多个 clue，gold document 在语义上包含 final answer，hard negative 则是经过标注与去重后未被保留为 positive 的抓取结果；第四类是部分公开的完整 agent episode。公开 run inventory 只有 BM25+GPT-5、BM25+o3、Qwen3-Embedding-8B+GPT-5 与 Qwen3-Embedding-8B+o3；这些文件是否各自覆盖全部 830 个查询，以及其成功/失败分布，尚未得到穷尽核验。

feedback contract 是 mixed。terminal validity 采用程序化规则：status 必须为 completed 且必须存在 final answer。retrieval 依据人类 qrels 计算 Recall@k 与 nDCG@k。citation recall 将 numeric cited document ID 与 evidence qrels 匹配，但不检查 sentence-level entailment。final-answer accuracy 需要 LLM semantic-equivalence judge：正式论文结果使用 GPT-4.1，而当前公开代码默认使用 Qwen/Qwen3-32B。经证据确认的 release 不包含 pairwise preference、process reward、learned reward model 或 optimizer。

相对 BrowseComp，变化并不是发布另一套 1,266 个问题，也不是替换原卡的 scorer 描述；变化在于围绕保留的 830-query subset 增加 controlled environment、document supervision、construction ledger 与部分 episode observability。该边界支持本卡的 category 选择与 related: [browsecomp-2025]，同时把 training_use 严格限制为 evaluation。

title: Method
方法
html:
Construction begins with BrowseComp's 1,266 question-answer pairs, but the BrowseComp-Plus benchmark release contains 830 retained items. OpenAI o3 with web search receives each original question and answer and is asked to produce clues, URLs, and evidence. The generator snapshot is unknown. It fails, abstains, or violates format on 124 cases, leaving 1,142. Selenium fetches cited pages and Trafilatura extracts text; removing 137 queries for which any cited URL cannot be scraped leaves 1,005 cases for human review.

Fourteen university students spend more than 400 hours verifying the candidates. They label evidence for every clue and require the combined evidence to support the complete answer; they label a document gold when it semantically contains the final answer. For an inadequate case, the protocol requires clue revision and at least 20 minutes of additional web search before rejection. Quality control includes about one hour of internal-development-set training, a 40-minute demonstration, group support, 10 cross-checked items per labeler, more than 80% agreement, and retrospective relabeling after detected mistakes. Compensation and consent are unknown. Human review retains 830 items; rejected item-level records are not released.

Hard-negative construction uses GPT-4o to decompose each retained question into approximately seven self-contained subqueries. SerpAPI returns up to 100 Google results for each subquery; the same Selenium/Trafilatura pipeline scrapes them before positives and negatives are deduplicated. The GPT-4o snapshot and exact deduplication method and threshold are unknown. The final fixed corpus has 100,195 documents, with means of 6.1 evidence documents, 2.9 gold documents, and 76.28 negatives per query; the mean document has 5,179.2 words and 32,296.2 characters.

At evaluation time, the agent searches a released fixed index. The main tool returns the top five documents, truncated to the first 512 tokens under the current code's Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B tokenizer. BM25 and Qwen3-Embedding indexes are released; ReasonIR and Jina-ColBERT are also evaluated. Some experiments expose get_document for full-document access. The action sequence is search, optional full-document retrieval, and final answer. The response template requests an explanation, numeric document citations, an exact answer, and confidence.

The producer schema can retain metadata, query ID, tool-call counts, usage, status, retrieved document IDs, and an ordered result stream containing tool calls, reasoning summaries, and output text. Returned responses with non-completed status may be serialized, but query-level exceptions can terminate before a record is persisted. Current evaluation first checks for status == completed and a final answer, then computes retrieval and citation metrics programmatically and answer accuracy with an LLM judge. The paper uses GPT-4.1; current code uses Qwen/Qwen3-32B with temperature 0.7, top-p 0.8, top-k 20, at most 4,096 output tokens, and thinking disabled.

Release components are distributed across separate official repositories: the 830-row query/label set, the 100,195-row corpus, indexes, code, and four encrypted trajectory JSONL files. The four combinations are BM25 or Qwen3-Embedding-8B paired with GPT-5 or o3. The code was inspected at commit 046949032b0328319cc9a02663a759ec601d9402; query, index, and run revisions are recorded in paper.yaml. No unified immutable manifest binds those revisions, and the corpus revision, proprietary API snapshots, seeds, retry policy, per-condition rollout count, and exhaustive trajectory coverage remain unknown.

构建链从 BrowseComp 的 1,266 个 question-answer pair 开始，但 BrowseComp-Plus benchmark release 最终只包含 830 个保留条目。OpenAI o3 with web search 接收每个原始问题与答案，并被要求输出 clue、URL 与 evidence；generator snapshot 为 unknown。124 个 case 因失败、abstention 或格式不合要求被移除，剩余 1,142 个。随后用 Selenium 获取引用页面并用 Trafilatura 提取文本；只要任一引用 URL 无法抓取，就移除该 query，因此再删去 137 个，留下 1,005 个进入人工审核。

14 名大学生投入超过 400 小时核验 candidate。他们为每个 clue 标注 evidence，并要求组合后的 evidence 支持完整 answer；如果一个 document 在语义上包含 final answer，就标为 gold。对于证据不足的 case，protocol 要求先修改 clue 并额外搜索网页至少 20 分钟，再决定 rejection。质量控制包括约 1 小时的 internal-development-set 训练、40 分钟演示、group support、每名 labeler 交叉检查 10 个 item、超过 80% agreement，以及发现错误后的回溯 relabeling。compensation 与 consent 为 unknown。人工审核最终保留 830 条，逐条 rejected record 未公开。

hard-negative 构建使用 GPT-4o，把每个保留问题分解为约 7 个 self-contained subquery。SerpAPI 为每个 subquery 返回最多 100 个 Google result，再由同一 Selenium/Trafilatura pipeline 抓取，之后对 positive 与 negative 去重。GPT-4o snapshot、准确 deduplication method 与 threshold 为 unknown。最终 fixed corpus 含 100,195 篇文档；每个 query 平均有 6.1 篇 evidence document、2.9 篇 gold document 与 76.28 篇 negative，平均每篇文档含 5,179.2 个词、32,296.2 个字符。

评测时，agent 在公开的 fixed index 上搜索。主工具返回 top-five 文档，并按当前代码中的 Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B tokenizer 截取每篇文档前 512 tokens。官方发布 BM25 与 Qwen3-Embedding index；论文还评测 ReasonIR 与 Jina-ColBERT。部分实验开放 get_document 以读取完整文档。action sequence 是 search、可选的 full-document retrieval 与 final answer；response template 要求 explanation、numeric document citation、准确答案与 confidence。

producer schema 可以保留 metadata、query ID、tool-call count、usage、status、retrieved document ID，以及包含 tool call、reasoning summary 与 output text 的有序 result stream。返回的 non-completed response 可能被序列化，但 query-level exception 可能在记录写入前终止。当前 evaluator 先检查 status == completed 且存在 final answer，再以程序化方式计算 retrieval/citation metric，并用 LLM judge 计算 answer accuracy。论文使用 GPT-4.1；当前代码使用 Qwen/Qwen3-32B，参数为 temperature 0.7、top-p 0.8、top-k 20、最多 4,096 output tokens，且关闭 thinking。

release component 分散在不同官方 repository：830-row query/label set、100,195-row corpus、index、code 与 4 个加密 trajectory JSONL file。四种组合是 BM25 或 Qwen3-Embedding-8B，分别搭配 GPT-5 或 o3。代码按 commit 046949032b0328319cc9a02663a759ec601d9402 检查；query、index 与 run revision 已记录在 paper.yaml。目前没有统一 immutable manifest 绑定这些 revision；corpus revision、闭源 API snapshot、seed、retry policy、每个 condition 的 rollout count 与 trajectory 的穷尽 coverage 仍为 unknown。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The paper demonstrates that the fixed retriever materially changes end-to-end answer accuracy under the reported setup. With GPT-5, BM25 yields 55.90% answer accuracy and 61.70 retrieval recall, while Qwen3-Embedding-8B yields 70.12% accuracy and 78.98 recall. GPT-4.1 moves from 14.58% with BM25 to 35.42% with Qwen3-Embedding-8B; SearchR1-32B moves from 3.86% to 10.36%. These are paper-reported evaluation results, not independently rerun measurements and not proof that the released data are suitable for training.

Retrieval-only results expose the gap behind the final score. For evidence qrels, BM25 reports R@5/R@1000/nDCG@10 of 1.2/13.7/1.6, compared with 14.5/76.7/20.3 for Qwen3-Embedding-8B. For gold-document qrels, the corresponding values are 1.4/17.3/1.7 and 18.5/83.5/19.5. Because qrels are incomplete, especially when new documents are added, these metrics can count genuinely relevant results as false negatives.

Several controlled checks locate other bottlenecks. Supplying all labeled positive documents gives GPT-4.1 93.49% accuracy, and the authors manually check the remaining 6.51% as answerable. Enabling get_document raises GPT-4.1 from 35.42% to 43.61% and Qwen3-32B from 10.36% to 11.69% in the reported setting. Reranking Qwen3-Embedding-8B's top 20 raises evidence R@5 from 14.5 to 23.3 and GPT-4.1 end-to-end accuracy from 35.42% to 47.11%. Higher reasoning effort raises gpt-oss-20B from 13.37% to 34.58% and gpt-oss-120B from 24.94% to 42.89% with the Qwen retriever. These comparisons isolate retrieval, document access, reranking, and inference effort; they do not establish a training recipe.

The 9,771,311-document FineWeb-Edu expansion is an audit of scale and qrel coverage. Qwen3-32B answer accuracy drops from 10.36% to 7.11%, while measured neural retrieval recall also drops partly because newly found relevant documents are not judged. This supports the paper's warning that corpus expansion and incomplete qrels are confounded rather than proving the larger corpus is worse.

Judge choice also moves the score. For GPT-5 with the Qwen3 retriever, substring matching, GPT-4.1 judgment, and Qwen3 judgment produce 65.18%, 70.12%, and 71.69%, respectively. Citation recall is below overall retrieval recall, but citation scoring only checks whether cited numeric document IDs appear in evidence qrels; it does not verify that a quoted sentence entails the claim. Reported parametric-only accuracy is roughly 20% for o3 and 26% for GPT-5, which the authors discuss as possible BrowseComp exposure. The fixed corpus controls search-time drift, not knowledge already present in model weights.

论文结果表明，在其报告的 setup 中，fixed retriever 会明显改变 end-to-end answer accuracy。GPT-5 使用 BM25 时 answer accuracy 为 55.90%、retrieval recall 为 61.70；使用 Qwen3-Embedding-8B 时分别为 70.12% 与 78.98。GPT-4.1 从 BM25 的 14.58% 提高到 Qwen3-Embedding-8B 的 35.42%；SearchR1-32B 则从 3.86% 提高到 10.36%。这些都是论文报告的 evaluation result，本次整理没有独立复跑，也不能证明公开数据适合训练。

retrieval-only result 揭示了 final score 背后的差距。对 evidence qrels，BM25 的 R@5/R@1000/nDCG@10 为 1.2/13.7/1.6，Qwen3-Embedding-8B 为 14.5/76.7/20.3；对 gold-document qrels，相应数值是 1.4/17.3/1.7 与 18.5/83.5/19.5。由于 qrels 不完整，尤其是在加入新文档后，这些 metric 可能把真实相关结果计为 false negative。

若干 controlled check 定位了其他 bottleneck。向 GPT-4.1 提供全部已标注 positive document 后，accuracy 达到 93.49%；作者人工检查剩余 6.51%，确认这些问题仍可回答。在报告的 setting 中，启用 get_document 后 GPT-4.1 从 35.42% 提高到 43.61%，Qwen3-32B 从 10.36% 提高到 11.69%。对 Qwen3-Embedding-8B 的 top 20 做 reranking 后，evidence R@5 从 14.5 提高到 23.3，GPT-4.1 end-to-end accuracy 从 35.42% 提高到 47.11%。在 Qwen retriever 下，提高 reasoning effort 使 gpt-oss-20B 从 13.37% 提高到 34.58%，gpt-oss-120B 从 24.94% 提高到 42.89%。这些比较区分了 retrieval、document access、reranking 与 inference effort，并未建立 training recipe。

扩展到 9,771,311 篇 FineWeb-Edu 文档的实验是对 scale 与 qrel coverage 的审计。Qwen3-32B answer accuracy 从 10.36% 降到 7.11%；neural retrieval 的 measured recall 也下降，部分原因是新增语料中的相关文档尚未被 judgment。该结果支持论文关于 corpus expansion 与 incomplete qrels 相互混杂的警告，不能据此证明更大的 corpus 本身更差。

judge choice 也会移动分数。GPT-5 搭配 Qwen3 retriever 时，substring matching、GPT-4.1 judgment 与 Qwen3 judgment 分别得到 65.18%、70.12% 与 71.69%。citation recall 低于 overall retrieval recall，但 citation scorer 只检查引用的 numeric document ID 是否出现在 evidence qrels 中，并不验证被引用句子是否蕴含 claim。论文报告 o3 与 GPT-5 的 parametric-only accuracy 约为 20% 与 26%，并讨论了可能的 BrowseComp exposure。fixed corpus 只能控制 search-time drift，不能清除模型权重中已有的知识。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The closest baseline is BrowseComp evaluated through live-web browsing and final-answer judgment. BrowseComp-Plus does not claim a new independent 1,266-item benchmark. It retains 830 parent questions that survive evidence collection, scraping, and human review, then attaches a fixed 100,195-document substrate, evidence/gold qrels, mined negatives, released indexes, retrieval and citation metrics, executable clients, and four frontier-agent trajectory archives.

The concrete change is diagnostic separation. A run can now fail because its terminal status is incomplete, its retriever misses labeled evidence, its citations omit retrieved evidence, or its synthesized answer fails semantic-equivalence judgment. This makes the environment and feedback contract inspectable at several levels rather than treating final-answer accuracy as a complete explanation of agent behavior.

The direction signal for reasoning-data curation is that a web-agent benchmark should package the retrieval substrate, document supervision, action/observation schema, terminal predicate, grader versions, and failed-run retention together. The fixed corpus, human label protocol, aggregate construction attrition, executable clients, and partial episode release are quality signals because they expose what can be audited; high benchmark scores are not quality signals by themselves.

The components are not individually new verifier classes. Fixed corpora, BM25 and neural retrieval, human qrels, LLM semantic judges, document-ID citation checks, and tool-call traces all predate this work. The contribution is their integration around BrowseComp questions and the resulting ability to disentangle retrieval from answer synthesis under a controlled substrate.

Reuse still requires checks the release does not close: count and status-audit all four trajectory archives, bind artifact revisions in one manifest, pin proprietary model and judge snapshots plus seeds and retries, measure qrel incompleteness, preserve exception failures, and clarify licenses and source-page rights. Until then, the resource is an evaluation benchmark and audit case, not a verified training corpus.

最接近的 baseline 是通过 live-web browsing 与 final-answer judgment 评测的 BrowseComp。BrowseComp-Plus 并未声称另行发布一个独立的 1,266-item benchmark；它从 parent questions 中保留通过 evidence collection、scraping 与人工审核的 830 条，再附加固定的 100,195-document substrate、evidence/gold qrels、挖掘的 negative、公开 index、retrieval/citation metric、可执行 client，以及四组 frontier-agent trajectory archive。

具体变化是 diagnostic separation。一个 run 现在可能因为 terminal status 不完整、retriever 漏掉已标注 evidence、citation 没有覆盖已检索 evidence，或 synthesized answer 未通过 semantic-equivalence judgment 而失败。由此 environment 与 feedback contract 可以在多个层面被检查，而不再把 final-answer accuracy 当作 agent behavior 的完整解释。

对 reasoning-data curation 的方向信号是：web-agent benchmark 应把 retrieval substrate、document supervision、action/observation schema、terminal predicate、grader version 与 failed-run retention 一起打包。fixed corpus、人类 label protocol、构建链的 aggregate attrition、可执行 client 与部分 episode release 是质量信号，因为它们暴露了可审计对象；高 benchmark score 本身不是质量信号。

各个组件并不是新的 verifier class。fixed corpus、BM25 与 neural retrieval、人类 qrels、LLM semantic judge、document-ID citation check 与 tool-call trace 都早于本工作。贡献在于围绕 BrowseComp question 整合这些组件，使研究者能在 controlled substrate 上分解 retrieval 与 answer synthesis。

复用前仍需完成 release 尚未闭合的检查：统计并审核四个 trajectory archive 的记录与 status；用一个 manifest 绑定 artifact revision；固定 proprietary model/judge snapshot、seed 与 retry；测量 qrel incompleteness；保留 exception failure；澄清 license 与 source-page rights。在这些问题解决前，该资源是 evaluation benchmark 与 audit case，而不是已经核验的 training corpus。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
• Question boundary and contamination. The benchmark release contains 830 filtered queries, not BrowseComp's original 1,266. Because the parent questions and answers are public and reversibly decodable, future models may absorb them. The reported roughly 20% o3 and 26% GPT-5 parametric-only accuracy is a possible exposure signal, not a contamination measurement.
  • Reversible canary. Query payloads use a public canary and base64/XOR transform derived from a public SHA-256 key. The key and decryptor are public, so this deters accidental ingestion but provides neither secrecy nor model-weight decontamination.
  • Incomplete qrels. Human evidence and gold labels cover the constructed pool, not every relevant document in the world or in an expanded corpus. Added relevant documents can be scored as false negatives; o3-generated candidate URLs also bias which evidence enters the pool. Retrieval and citation metrics must therefore be read as judgments against incomplete qrels.
  • Citation predicate. Citation scoring matches numeric document IDs against evidence qrels. It does not check whether the cited passage entails the associated claim, whether the citation is placed correctly, or whether the final explanation is complete.
  • Judge drift. The archival paper uses GPT-4.1 for semantic equivalence, while current public code defaults to Qwen/Qwen3-32B. Appendix G reports 65.18%, 70.12%, and 71.69% for substring, GPT-4.1, and Qwen3 grading on the same GPT-5 plus Qwen3-retriever condition. A score without the judge snapshot, prompt, and configuration is not an exact reproduction.
  • Failure retention. Current producer code can serialize returned responses with non-completed status, and evaluation treats non-completed or missing-output runs as failures or parse errors. Query-level exceptions may stop before any record is written. Construction rejects are disclosed only as aggregate counts, and the four public run files have not been exhaustively audited for row count or completed/incomplete/error distributions.
  • Partial trajectory release. Only BM25+GPT-5, BM25+o3, Qwen3-Embedding-8B+GPT-5, and Qwen3-Embedding-8B+o3 archives are visible. No released trajectories were verified for other evaluated agents or retrievers, and coverage of all 830 items in each visible file is unknown.
  • Extraction and task scope. Selenium/Trafilatura text extraction omits or degrades interactive pages, dynamic layouts, multimedia, and some PDF content. Forty-two map/distance tasks and thirteen ambiguous or non-unique-answer tasks were among explicit removals. The retained benchmark assesses short answers and document citations, not full deep-research reports.
  • Version and exact replay. Code and Hugging Face artifacts have separate histories, the repository has no release tag, the corpus revision is unknown, and no immutable manifest binds queries, corpus, indexes, trajectories, prompts, dependencies, agents, and graders. Proprietary API snapshots, seeds, retry state, some service versions, and rollout counts are undisclosed; exact historical replay is therefore false even though controlled reruns are more feasible than on a live web.
  • License and privacy. Code and the query/corpus/index repository cards show MIT metadata, arXiv v1 is CC BY 4.0, the archival-paper license is recorded as unknown, and the trajectory repository has no verified license. Repository-level MIT metadata does not establish rights to relicense scraped third-party pages. PII scanning, robots/terms review, takedown procedure, and annotator compensation and consent are unknown.
  • Use boundary. Evidence supports evaluation only. The paper does not establish SFT, distillation, preference learning, reward modeling, process supervision, RLVR, or agent-training use, and benchmark performance does not prove data quality or training utility.

• 问题边界与 contamination。 benchmark release 包含 830 个 filtered query，不是 BrowseComp 原始的 1,266 条。由于 parent question 与 answer 已公开且可逆解码，未来模型可能吸收这些内容。论文报告 o3 与 GPT-5 的 parametric-only accuracy 约为 20% 与 26%，这只能视为可能的 exposure signal，不是 contamination measurement。
  • 可逆 canary。 query payload 使用公开 canary，以及由公开 SHA-256 key 派生的 base64/XOR transform。key 与 decryptor 都公开，因此只能阻止意外摄入，既不提供保密性，也不能对 model weight 去污染。
  • 不完整 qrels。 人类 evidence 与 gold label 覆盖构建出的候选池，并非全世界或扩展 corpus 中的所有相关文档。新增的相关文档可能被计为 false negative；o3 生成的 candidate URL 也会影响哪些 evidence 进入 pool。因此 retrieval/citation metric 必须理解为相对于 incomplete qrels 的 judgment。
  • Citation predicate。 citation scorer 只把 numeric document ID 与 evidence qrels 匹配；它不检查引用 passage 是否蕴含对应 claim、citation placement 是否正确，或 final explanation 是否完整。
  • Judge 漂移。 正式论文以 GPT-4.1 判断 semantic equivalence，而当前公开代码默认使用 Qwen/Qwen3-32B。Appendix G 在同一个 GPT-5 plus Qwen3-retriever condition 上，给出 substring、GPT-4.1 与 Qwen3 grading 分别为 65.18%、70.12% 与 71.69%。未注明 judge snapshot、prompt 与 configuration 的分数不能视为准确复现。
  • 失败保留。 当前 producer code 可以序列化带 non-completed status 的返回 response；evaluator 把 non-completed 或 missing-output run 视为 failure 或 parse error。但 query-level exception 可能在写入任何记录前终止。construction reject 只公开 aggregate count，四个 public run file 也尚未被穷尽核验其 row count 或 completed/incomplete/error 分布。
  • 部分 trajectory release。 可见 archive 只有 BM25+GPT-5、BM25+o3、Qwen3-Embedding-8B+GPT-5 与 Qwen3-Embedding-8B+o3。其他被评测 agent 或 retriever 没有已核验的公开 trajectory；每个可见文件是否覆盖全部 830 条也为 unknown。
  • 提取与任务范围。 Selenium/Trafilatura 文本提取会遗漏或损伤 interactive page、dynamic layout、multimedia 与部分 PDF content。明确移除的条目包括 42 个 map/distance task 与 13 个 ambiguous 或 non-unique-answer task。保留的 benchmark 评测短答案与 document citation，不是完整 deep-research report。
  • 版本与准确 replay。 code 与 Hugging Face artifact 各有独立 history，repository 没有 release tag，corpus revision 为 unknown，也没有 immutable manifest 绑定 query、corpus、index、trajectory、prompt、dependency、agent 与 grader。proprietary API snapshot、seed、retry state、部分 service version 与 rollout count 未披露；因此即使 controlled rerun 比 live web 更可行，准确历史 replay 仍为 false。
  • License 与隐私。 code 以及 query/corpus/index repository card 显示 MIT metadata，arXiv v1 为 CC BY 4.0，archival-paper license 记录为 unknown，trajectory repository 则没有已核验 license。repository-level MIT metadata 不能证明第三方 scraped page 可被重新许可。PII scan、robots/terms review、takedown procedure、annotator compensation 与 consent 均为 unknown。
  • 用途边界。 证据只支持 evaluation。论文没有建立 SFT、distillation、preference learning、reward modeling、process supervision、RLVR 或 agent-training use；benchmark performance 也不能证明 data quality 或 training utility。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the assigned environment_agent_trajectory_data track, BrowseComp-Plus is useful as a controlled evaluation substrate for search-agent episodes. The 830 query records can be joined to a fixed 100,195-document corpus, human evidence/gold qrels, hard negatives, released indexes, and episode outputs. This lets an evaluator represent query, environment state, search action, returned observation, retrieved IDs, terminal status, cited answer, and separate feedback outputs instead of retaining only a final accuracy bit.

The mixed feedback contract supports failure attribution. Researchers can distinguish a terminal or parsing failure from missing retrieval evidence, weak ranking, failure to cite retrieved evidence, and semantic answer failure. The paper's retriever, reranker, get_document, oracle-positive-document, inference-effort, corpus-expansion, and judge-comparison experiments provide concrete templates for controlled ablations. Any follow-up should report judge and artifact versions and should not interpret score gains as proof of dataset quality.

The construction process is also a benchmark-building recipe: start from hard factual questions, use a search-enabled model to propose clue/evidence URLs, scrape and parse pages, retain only recoverable cases, train and cross-check human annotators, label evidence and gold documents, mine hard negatives from decomposed subqueries, freeze a corpus and indexes, expose an agent tool, and evaluate retrieval, citations, terminal validity, and final answers separately. A stronger reuse would additionally preserve rejected items, deduplication logic, source-level rights, immutable versions, and all successful and failed episodes.

The four public GPT-5/o3 run archives are valuable for trajectory-schema and cost/behavior audits, but they are a partial release rather than a general training dataset. Before episode-level research, count and decrypt every file, measure completed/incomplete/error coverage, verify that all intended query IDs are present, and pin the producer, retriever, model, prompt, judge, dependency, and artifact revisions. Exact historical replay remains unsupported because proprietary API snapshots, seeds, retry state, and a unified manifest are absent.

The safe evidenced use is evaluation and audit only. The benchmark can compare retrievers and agents on a more stable substrate than the live web and can guide release standards for replayable web-agent data. The paper does not support treating its questions, qrels, documents, or trajectories as SFT examples, preference pairs, reward-model targets, process supervision, RLVR rewards, or agent-training rollouts. Those uses would require an explicit license, split/decontamination policy, full provenance, failure retention, and a separate study of training validity.

对指定的 environment_agent_trajectory_data track，BrowseComp-Plus 可作为 search-agent episode 的 controlled evaluation substrate。830 条 query record 可以连接到固定的 100,195-document corpus、人类 evidence/gold qrels、hard negative、公开 index 与 episode output。这样 evaluator 可以分别表示 query、environment state、search action、returned observation、retrieved ID、terminal status、cited answer 与多种 feedback output，而不是只保留一个 final accuracy bit。

mixed feedback contract 支持 failure attribution。研究者可以区分 terminal/parsing failure、未检索到 evidence、ranking 较弱、未引用已检索 evidence 与 semantic answer failure。论文中的 retriever、reranker、get_document、oracle-positive-document、inference-effort、corpus-expansion 与 judge-comparison 实验提供了具体的 controlled ablation 模板。任何后续工作都应报告 judge 与 artifact version，也不能把 score gain 解释成 dataset quality 的证明。

构建过程也构成一条 benchmark-building recipe：从困难事实问题出发，用具备 search 能力的模型提出 clue/evidence URL，抓取并解析页面，只保留可恢复证据的 case，训练并交叉检查 human annotator，标注 evidence 与 gold document，从分解后的 subquery 挖掘 hard negative，固定 corpus 与 index，开放 agent tool，并分别评测 retrieval、citation、terminal validity 与 final answer。更强的复用还应保留 rejected item、deduplication logic、source-level rights、immutable version，以及全部 successful/failed episode。

四组公开 GPT-5/o3 run archive 对 trajectory schema 与成本/行为审计有价值，但它们是 partial release，不是通用 training dataset。在做 episode-level research 前，应逐个解密并计数，测量 completed/incomplete/error coverage，确认所有预期 query ID 是否存在，并固定 producer、retriever、model、prompt、judge、dependency 与 artifact revision。由于缺少 proprietary API snapshot、seed、retry state 与 unified manifest，准确历史 replay 仍不受支持。

证据支持的安全用途是仅限 evaluation 与 audit。该 benchmark 可在比 live web 更稳定的 substrate 上比较 retriever 与 agent，也可用于制定 replayable web-agent data 的 release 标准。论文不支持把其 question、qrels、document 或 trajectory 当作 SFT example、preference pair、reward-model target、process supervision、RLVR reward 或 agent-training rollout。若要开展这些用途，必须另有明确 license、split/decontamination policy、完整 provenance、failure retention 与训练有效性研究。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Keep the identity boundary explicit: browsecomp-plus-2025 uses the stable first-arXiv year in its ID, but canonical metadata are the ACL 2026 title, venue, year, and 21-author list; browsecomp-2025 remains a separate related parent entry.
  • Start from the released object: 830 test queries, not 1,266; a fixed 100,195-document corpus; human evidence/gold qrels; hard negatives; indexes; executable clients; and only four visible full-trajectory archives.
  • Read the verifier as mixed and versioned: programmatic terminal, retrieval, and document-ID citation checks coexist with an LLM semantic-equivalence judge. Paper scores use GPT-4.1, while current code defaults to Qwen/Qwen3-32B, and the two are not numerically interchangeable.
  • Audit the partial release before reuse: trajectory row counts and status distributions, exception failures, qrel false negatives, reversible canary protection, artifact revisions, scraped-content rights, trajectory license, privacy handling, and exact-replay inputs remain incomplete or unknown.
  • Keep use limited to evaluation and audit. Retriever or agent score gains do not prove data quality, and the paper does not establish SFT, preference, reward-model, process-supervision, RLVR, or agent-training use.

• 明确保留 identity boundary：browsecomp-plus-2025 的 ID 使用首次 arXiv 年份，但 canonical metadata 采用 ACL 2026 的标题、venue、年份与 21 位作者；browsecomp-2025 仍是独立的 related parent entry。
  • 先看 released object：830 个 test query，不是 1,266 个；固定的 100,195-document corpus；人类 evidence/gold qrels；hard negative；index；可执行 client；以及仅有的四组可见完整 trajectory archive。
  • 把 verifier 理解为 mixed 且有版本：程序化 terminal、retrieval 与 document-ID citation check 和 LLM semantic-equivalence judge 同时存在。论文分数使用 GPT-4.1，当前代码默认使用 Qwen/Qwen3-32B，两者在数值上不能互换。
  • 复用前审计 partial release：trajectory row count 与 status distribution、exception failure、qrel false negative、可逆 canary protection、artifact revision、scraped-content rights、trajectory license、privacy handling 与准确 replay input 仍不完整或为 unknown。
  • 用途仅限 evaluation 与 audit。retriever 或 agent 的 score gain 不能证明 data quality，论文也没有建立 SFT、preference、reward-model、process-supervision、RLVR 或 agent-training use。
